critique: The ISO render reads convincingly as an FPGA NTT card — eight glass BRAM banks line the left edge, the copper multiplier column and dark/steel add-sub pairs populate the open frame, and the finned heatsink and twiddle ROM are clearly nameable; nothing is sunk below the ground line. The weakest spot is the exploded radix-4 butterfly: in the SIDE view it reads as a near-empty dark plate floating on a post because its W1/W2/W3 multipliers, j-rotator and add/sub trees are too small and tightly stacked to parse, so the X-ray centerpiece under-delivers. There is also a stale self-consistency defect: addr_gen_unit's note still claimed the committed XOR-fold 'fails per-stage operand-distinctness at large strides,' directly contradicting crossbar_network's correct GF(2)-linear proof that it is conflict-free for every power-of-two stride including 512. The headline reproducibility gaps (paper's true Sec. III bank/offset map, twiddle-reuse addressing f(stage,block), exact FSM table, naive-radix-4 baseline, bit-reversal-free hardware, the specific 14-bit prime, PCIe framing) remain source-missing stand-ins that geometry cannot fix — they belong to the evidence/amend loop and are preserved unweakened.
changelog: Enlarged the exploded radix-4 multipliers W1/W2/W3 (radius 0.36->0.40, length 0.8->0.95) and spread them in Z (1.9/2.4/2.9 -> 1.75/2.4/3.05) so the three twiddle stages read as distinct units in ISO/SIDE.
Grew the exploded j-rotator torus (0.22/0.06 -> 0.27/0.08) and the exploded output register (0.4x0.55x0.9 -> 0.44x0.6x0.95) so the rotator and latch are legible against the add/sub trees.
Widened the exploded baseplate depth (Z 1.9 -> 2.1) to host the re-spread datapath without overhang.

Fixed addr_gen_unit's contradictory note: replaced the stale 'conflict-free only for power-of-two strides / fails at large strides' text with the correct GF(2)-linear statement (b(i) XOR b(i+2^k)=fold(2^k)!=0 for every power-of-two stride incl. 512), aligning it with crossbar_network while keeping the [source-missing] tag on the paper's true map.
Carried every spec block, metadata.spec, thumbnail_camera, mode/reference/info through unchanged.
